dedupe_keys.name: occupation en temps reel des parkings

description: Occupation en temps réel des parkings is a dataset listed in Plateforme Open Data Ville et Eurométropole de Strasbourg, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a region, department, metropolitan area or agency, published or maintained by Eurométropole de Strasbourg. Nombre de places disponibles dans les parkings ouvragés de l'Eurométropole. Les données sont rafraichies toutes les 3 minutes. Ce jeu de données peut être utilisé conjointement avec le jeu de données qui décrit en détail chaque parking (position, horaires,...). Coverage: Strasbourg Eurométropole. The portal files it under Mobilité, Transports. Its keywords are parking, stationnement, place, temps réel, Strasbourg. The portal shows 35 records. It carries geographic features and can be exported as GeoJSON, KML or Shapefile. The portal shows 2026-09-29 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Licence Ouverte (Etalab) (https://www.etalab.gouv.fr/wp-content/uploads/2014/05/Licence_Ouverte.pdf). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-data-strasbourg-eu-portal.
